Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an S3 bucket suitable for hosting application user uploads with appropriate access controls.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: S3 bucket for application user uploads with secure defaults and appropriate access controls.

Parameters:
  BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional. Provide a globally-unique S3 bucket name. If empty, CloudFormation will generate one.
    AllowedPattern: '(^$)|(^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$)'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid S3 bucket name (3-63 chars, lowercase, numbers, dots, hyphens).
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional. Provide an existing KMS Key ARN to use for SSE-KMS. If empty, a new key will be created.
    AllowedPattern: '(^$)|(^arn:aws(-[a-z]+)?:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:\d{12}:key\/[a-f0-9-]+$)'
  AllowedCorsOrigins:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional. Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins for browser uploads (e.g. https://app.example.com,https://admin.example.com). Leave empty to disable CORS.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - prod
      - staging
      - dev
    Description: Environment tag for resources.
  Application:
    Type: String
    Default: user-uploads
    Description: Application name tag.

Conditions:
  UseProvidedBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BucketName, '']]
  UseProvidedKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]
  CreateKmsKey: !Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']
  UseCors: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AllowedCorsOrigins, '']]

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateKmsKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: SSE-KMS key for S3 user uploads
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: key-default-1
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowUseOfKeyForS3InThisAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
                kms:CallerAccount: !Sub ${AWS::AccountId}
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateKmsKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/s3-${AWS::StackName}-uploads
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  UploadBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If [UseProvidedBucketName, !Ref BucketName, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If [UseProvidedKmsKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn]
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
          - Id: NoncurrentVersionLifecycle
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 180
              NewerNoncurrentVersions: 10
      CorsConfiguration: !If
        - UseCors
        - CorsRules:
            - AllowedMethods: [GET, PUT, POST, HEAD]
              AllowedOrigins: !Split [",", !Ref AllowedCorsOrigins]
              AllowedHeaders: ["*"]
              ExposedHeaders: ["ETag", "x-amz-request-id", "x-amz-version-id"]
              MaxAge: 3600
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  UploadBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref UploadBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt UploadBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${UploadBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false
          - Sid: EnforceKMSEncryptionAlgorithmIfSpecified
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:PutObject"
            Resource: !Sub "${UploadBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms
              Null:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: false
          - Sid: EnforceSpecificKmsKeyIfSpecified
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:PutObject"
            Resource: !Sub "${UploadBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id: !If [UseProvidedKmsKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn]
              Null:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id: false

Outputs:
  UploadBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for user uploads
    Value: !Ref UploadBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UploadBucketName"
  UploadBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 bucket for user uploads
    Value: !GetAtt UploadBucket.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UploadBucketArn"
  SseKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for bucket default encryption
    Value: !If [UseProvidedKmsKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SseKmsKeyArn"
